scope: bounded deterministic dependency/retry/approval/kill-switch/compensation workflow; no external action runner or actual tool-side rollback claim; actual monotonic timer release and asynchronous native RCL process with source-owned sampled-deadline publication, cancellation/exit observation and failure settlement; local soft realtime, no hard OS interrupt/timing guarantee or external effects

independentGeneration.requestedToolPolicy: read only named frozen candidates; no other filesystem, memory, network, tools or writes

runtimeControls: actual monotonic timers and asynchronous native process exit
RCL-owned admission/publication and full independent controller replay
release wait, bounded backpressure, past-deadline/time-reversal/source-authority rejection, native timeout/cancel and healthy recovery
authorityProfile: RCL conditional warrants own local sampled-deadline publication; Node transports clock observations, stops owned processes and waits for real exit; no hard realtime/OS interruption guarantee

trials.intent: A task dependency names a previously completed task index; reject a dependency at or beyond the number of completed tasks.
Success requires one additional attempt after all planned failures; reject when failures consume the entire attempt budget.
Stop a workflow before an approval-required task if human approval is absent; approved tasks may proceed if dependencies and retries permit.
